admin.lowRatingFlag: Flag: average rating {avg} across 3+ reviews. Consider reviewing this mentor.
admin.check.identity: I verified their identity (video call or ID)
admin.check.credential: I verified their credentials with an official source
admin.check.sample: The sample answer shows real expertise
admin.checklistNeeded: Tick all three checks before approving.
admin.title: Mentor applications
admin.notAuthorized: You're not the admin account for this site.
admin.reasonRequired: Please write a reason. The applicant will see it.
admin.bk.refundConfirm: Refund this booking in full? The buyer is repaid and the mentor loses this payout. This cannot be undone.
admin.bk.notRefundable: This booking can no longer be refunded.
admin.po.help: Mentors' earnings become payable {days} days after they answer. Send each bank transfer yourself, then click Mark as paid and enter the bank reference.
admin.po.empty: Nobody is owed anything right now.
admin.po.noIban: This mentor has no payout details yet.
admin.po.debtExceeds: Refunds after payout are larger than new earnings. Nothing can be paid until they are covered.
admin.po.refRequired: Enter the bank transfer reference first.
admin.po.confirmPaid: Record that you have sent {amount} to this mentor's bank account? Only do this after the transfer is made.
admin.po.confirmSettle: This mentor’s earnings and refunds cancel each other out, so no transfer is needed. Record this settlement?
admin.po.changed: The amount changed since you loaded this page. It has been reloaded, so please check it again.
admin.po.nothing: There is nothing left to pay.
admin.bk.refundConfirmPaidOut: This mentor has already been paid for this answer. The buyer will be refunded, and the amount will be recorded as owed back by the mentor and deducted from their next payout. Continue?
admin.bk.refundedOwed: Refund requested. The mentor owes this amount back.
admin.bk.refundFailed: The bank rejected the refund. It is saved and will be retried; see the problem shown on the booking.
admin.mv.anyOf: At least one of these is required:
admin.mv.reasonRequired: Please write a reason of at least 5 characters.
admin.mv.approveBlocked: Every required step must pass before you can approve.
admin.mv.flag.name_mismatch: A name does not match the ID. Check it by hand; it was not approved automatically.
admin.mv.flag.payout_name_mismatch: The payout account holder does not match the ID. Payouts are held until this is resolved.
admin.po.flagged: Payout on hold: the account holder name does not match the ID. Resolve the flag in the mentor review first.
admin.mv.docsNote: Only admins can open these. Every download is logged. Files are deleted 90 days after a decision.
admin.iv.notStarted: You can record the result once the interview time has passed.
admin.iv.invalidSlot: Pick a date and time in the future (within 120 days).
admin.iv.invalidLink: Enter a full https:// meeting link.
admin.q.answersHelp: A new mentor's first answers wait here, and the buyer cannot see them yet. Approve them, or they are released automatically after {hours} hours unless you hold them for a closer look.
admin.q.flagged: Held for a closer look: it will not be released automatically.
admin.q.mentorFlagged: This mentor has an open flag: it will not be released automatically.
admin.q.rejectConfirm: Reject this answer and refund the buyer?
admin.mv.flag.reports: Reported by {count} people. See the review queue.
admin.mv.flag.license_expiring: The license expires on {date}. Ask for the renewed one.
admin.mv.flag.license_expired: The license expired on {date}. The mentor was taken off the site.
admin.mv.suspendConfirm: Suspend {name} now? They disappear from Browse experts and every question waiting for their answer is refunded.
admin.po.suspended: Payout on hold: this mentor is suspended. Reinstate them in the mentor review or decide about their earnings first.
admin.wl.empty: Nobody has asked to be notified yet.
admin.wl.help: People who asked to be told when a mentor in their field joins. Each gets one email when a matching mentor is listed.
admin.launch.banner: Prelaunch mode: nobody can pay yet, and visitors are joining the waiting list (see the Waiting list tab: counts per field and a CSV export). Set LAUNCH_MODE=live to open.
admin.rv.askersHelp: Their average from mentors is under 2.5, after at least 3 ratings.
admin.rv.hideConfirm: Hide this review? It disappears from the profile and from the average. Your reason is logged.
admin.dev.help: Moves this booking's clock forward, then runs the daily checks now: an unanswered question is refunded, a held answer is released, ratings are revealed, earnings become payable.
admin.dev.changed.payable: The mentor's earnings are now payable.
admin.mv.reinstateNote: Reinstated mentors go back to review. Approve again to list them.
admin.mv.reinstateReadyNote: Every verification step is still valid, so you can reinstate and approve in one click.
admin.mv.reinstateNotReady: Some verification steps are no longer valid: reinstating puts the mentor back in review until they pass again.
admin.mv.reinstated: Reinstated: the mentor is back in review. Approve again to list them.
admin.mv.reapproved: Reinstated and approved again: the mentor is listed.
admin.tf.expired: Your two-step verification has expired. Reloading to sign in again…
